text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian!
Narita Brian finishes in first place!
(Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...You really are a monster.
Just how strong are you going to get?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Were you afraid?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Are you stupid?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just look forward to it.
To me taking you down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I will not wait for that, however.
For I must keep pressing forward.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. Keep walking while you wait.
I'll catch up to you in no time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
Narita Brian and the others silently reach their hands out in front of each other.

Surrounded by thunderous applause,
the two clasped hands tightly.
And a few days later. In front of a certain hospital—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you hear from your mother?
Your older sister is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, Brian. What's the matter? You're completely out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Mom!
...Is your leg really completely fine now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
I've made a complete recovery.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "I finally got the doctor's stamp of approval. My legs can move properly now too."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It certainly took some time, though.
It seems I can finally compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, sis. Back when you
invited me to Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "What would you have done if I'd told you I wasn't going to the Academy?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Did you keep running in the Twinkle Series ahead of me anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. This is purely
a hypothetical scenario, of course.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I kept running.
Honing myself until I was ready to satisfy your thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see... You truly are strong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Got it.
Let's meet up there.
